subject: Skip Mack Glitch
text: Walk up the uncarpeted part of the left-hand stairs toward the Shysters and jump onto their heads when you get the opportunity.

evidence.quote: Approach the Shysters on the left-hand side by walking up the part of the stairs on that side not covered by carpet. Jump onto their heads when you get the opportunity.

subject: Skip Mack Glitch
text: Walk along the Shysters' heads and jump off onto the platform where Mack and the throne are; done correctly, the cutscene before the Mack fight does not trigger.

evidence.quote: You can now walk along their heads. Jump off their heads onto the platform where Mack and the throne are. If you do it correctly, you won't trigger the cutscene that occurs right before fighting Mack.

subject: Skip Mack Glitch
object: first Star Piece without fighting Mack
text: Talking to the Chancellor afterward makes the game proceed as if Mack was defeated and the first Star Piece obtained.

evidence.quote: Now you can walk right up to the Chancellor and talk to him. When you do, the game will proceed as if you have already defeated Mack and obtained the first Star Piece!

subject: Skip Mack Glitch
text: The graphics are briefly confused after the glitch, and the only gameplay drawback is that you cannot view the Star Piece menu.

evidence.quote: you won't be able to view the Star Piece menu. As that menu is largely useless anyway, it's not a huge loss.

subject: Vine Climbing
text: On the second screen in the clouds, counting from entering via Bean Valley's beanstalk, there are two vines to climb.

evidence.quote: On the second screen in the clouds (counting from when you first enter the clouds via Bean Valley's beanstalk), there are two vines to climb.

subject: Vine Climbing
location: Clouds above Bean Valley, second screen
text: Take the left vine to its peak and jump to reveal a treasure chest.

evidence.quote: Take the left vine to its peak and jump to reveal a treasure chest.

subject: Vine Climbing
location: Clouds above Bean Valley, second screen
text: Climb the other vine, jump onto the top of the chest, then use the chest to jump onto the previously unreachable vine and climb it to the next area.

evidence.quote: climb the other vine up until you can jump onto the top of the treasure chest. Use the chest to jump onto the vine previously out of reach and climb it to the next area.

subject: Vine Climbing
text: Jump onto a yellow vine and jump to reveal a hidden platform, then get on the yellow platform and make a running jump to the green vine to find treasure chests with items.

evidence.quote: Climb up until you jump onto a yellow vine, then jump to reveal a hidden platform. Make your way around and up until you can get on the yellow platform, then make a running jump to the green vine. Climb up to find some treasure chests with items inside.

subject: Beetle Mania
text: After rescuing Toadstool from Booster, a toad playing a handheld game on the Inn's first floor in the Mushroom Kingdom can be interrupted enough times that he offers to sell the game.

evidence.quote: Anytime after you've rescued Toadstool from Booster, head to the first floor of the Inn in the Mushroom Kingdom. There will be a toad playing a handheld game in the corner. Interrupt him enough times

subject: Beetle Mania
text: The toad offers to sell the handheld game for 500 Coins.

evidence.quote: offer to sell you the game for 500 Coins

subject: Beetle Mania
text: BeetleMania can be accessed from the X menu at any time in the overworld.

evidence.quote: It can be accessed from the X menu at any time in the overworld.

subject: Beetle Mania
text: You control a beetle along the bottom of the screen and shoot down turtle shells by firing stars with any of the four buttons (A, B, X, Y); if hit, mash the buttons to recover.

evidence.quote: Your objective is to shoot down the turtle shells by firing stars with any of the four buttons (A, B, X, Y) on the controller. If you get hit, rapidly mash the buttons to recover.

subject: Beetle Mania
text: High scores come from the shrapnel of destroyed shells, which creates a damage ring that can chain-react and wreck multiple turtle shells at once.

evidence.quote: Each time you destroy a turtle shell, it creates a ring of damage around it that can start a chain reaction, wrecking multiple turtle shells in one go.

subject: Three Musty Fears
text: Resting at the door right of the Item Shop in Monstro Town, the three ghosts called the Three Musty Fears visit at night and ask you to find three flags planted around the world.

evidence.quote: The door to the right of the Item Shop in Monstro Town serves as a kind of Inn for resting and restoring HP and FP. There's a catch: in the middle of the night, you'll be visited by three ghosts who call themselves the Three Musty Fears.

subject: Greaper
text: Greaper's Flag is in Rose Town; press A behind the flower-shaped Welcome sign.

evidence.quote: 1. Greaper's Flag: In Rose Town. Press **A** behind the flower-shaped Welcome sign.

subject: Dry Bones
text: Dry Bones's Flag is in Mario's Pad; press A in front of the bed.

evidence.quote: 2. Dry Bones's Flag: In Mario's Pad. Press **A** in front of the bed.

subject: Big Boo
text: Big Boo's flag is in Yo'ster Isle; press A between the letters O and A in the word GOAL.

evidence.quote: 3. Big Boo: In Yo'ster Isle. Press **A** between the letters O and A in the word **GOAL**.

subject: Three Musty Fears
text: With all three flags, return to Monstro Town and sleep again; the Fears congratulate you and equip the Ghost Medal onto Mario.

evidence.quote: Once you have all three flags, return to Monstro Town and sleep again. The Fears will reappear, congratulate you on finding their flags, and equip the Ghost Medal onto Mario.

subject: Ghost Medal
text: The Ghost Medal raises defense while attacking and is worth 800 coins.

evidence.quote: The Ghost Medal raises your defense while attacking; more importantly, it's worth 800 coins

subject: Grate Guy's Casino
text: Getting to the Casino starts at Booster Tower after clearing Marrymore, where you climb until you meet Knife Guy juggling balls on a staircase.

evidence.quote: First, go to Booster Tower after you've cleared Marrymore. Climb the tower until you encounter former boss Knife Guy juggling some multi-colored balls on a staircase.

subject: Knife Guy game
text: Knife Guy's game is to guess which hand holds the yellow ball; each win gives an item and raises the win counter, each loss lowers it by one, and 13 wins earn the Bright Card.

evidence.quote: The game is to guess which hand is holding the yellow ball. Every time you win, you'll obtain an item and your win counter goes up; every time you lose, the win counter goes down by one. You have to win the game 13 times in order to receive the Bright Card

subject: Knife Guy game
text: Watch the yellow ball just before the juggling ends: if it was in the front it will be in Knife Guy's left hand, if in the back his right hand.

evidence.quote: If the yellow ball was in the front, it will be in Knife Guy's left hand. If the ball was in the back, it will be in his right hand.

subject: Bright Card
text: With the Bright Card, go to the Bean Valley screen with five pipes and enter the top pipe closest to the Save Block, after the Shy Guy waters the Smilax and you fight it.

evidence.quote: go to Bean Valley and find the screen with five pipes. Enter the pipe at the top, closest to the Save Block. (As usual with this screen, you'll have to wait for the Shy Guy to water the Smilax, then fight the Smilax, in order to gain access.)

subject: Grate Guy's Casino
object: jump three times in far left corner
text: In the pipe area with three lizard enemies and a Gold Chomp, clear the Chomp, go to the far left corner and jump three times (chime each time); on the third a platform appears leading to an exit that unlocks the path to Grate Guy's Casino.

evidence.quote: This area has three lizard enemies and a Gold Chomp. Clear out the Chomp, then go to the far left corner and jump three times. You'll know you've found the right spot because each time you jump, you will hear a chime. On the third jump, a platform will appear, leading you to an exit.

subject: Star Egg
text: Grate Guy's Look the Other Way requires looking in the opposite direction of where Grate Guy looks; there is no win/loss counter and you must win 100 times to receive the Star Egg.

evidence.quote: The goal is to look in the opposite direction of where Grate Guy looks; so if he looks left, you'll want to be looking right, and vice versa. There's no real trick to this game, but fortunately there's no win/loss counter like with Knife Guy; you simply have to win 100 times to receive the Star Egg.

subject: Bright Card
text: After the Casino, the Bright Card can be sold to a man outside the Marrymore chapel: refuse 100 Coins, then 5 Frog Coins, and the price rises to 10 Frog Coins; it can be bought back for 15 Frog Coins.

evidence.quote: You can refuse his first offer of 100 Coins; he'll then offer 5 Frog Coins. Refuse again and the price goes up to 10 Frog Coins. You can buy the Card back for 15 Frog Coins, as well.

subject: Marrymore bellhop
text: The Marrymore Hotel deluxe suite costs more than the normal room, covers one night, and you can stay as many nights as you like as long as you do not go downstairs to the lobby.

evidence.quote: you can buy the deluxe suite at the Hotel for a higher price than the normal room (both rooms will heal you when you sleep in the bed). The cost only covers a one- night stay, but you are quite free to stay as many nights as you like, as long as you don't go downstairs to the lobby.

subject: Marrymore bellhop
text: Going down to the lobby after overstaying makes the owner subtract the total cost from your funds; if that bankrupts you, you must work as a bellhop until the debt is paid.

evidence.quote: the owner will subtract the total cost of your stay from your current funds. If he winds up bankrupting you, you'll have to work as a bellhop in the Hotel until you've paid off your debt.

subject: Marrymore bellhop
text: As a bellhop you take customers who pay for the deluxe suite upstairs and explain everything, then talk to them for a tip; leading one customer up pays for one overstayed night and when the debt is repaid you are released.

evidence.quote: when a customer pays for the deluxe suite, you take them upstairs and explain everything, just like the original bellhop did when you stayed there. Afterwards, talk to the customers and see if you get a tip off of them. Leading one customer up to the suite will pay for one of the extra nights you overstayed in the suite.

subject: Melody Bay
object: right side of Tadpole Pond main screen
text: Melody Bay is off the right side of the main screen of Tadpole Pond: a pond set up like musical notation with Toadofsky on the other side, who needs help composing by playing songs on the pond.

evidence.quote: Off to the right side of the main screen of Tadpole Pond is an area called Melody Bay. It features a large pond set up almost like a piece of musical notation, with a Toad named Toadofsky standing on the other side.

subject: Melody Bay
text: From left to right the notes are Mi Re Do Ti La So Fa.

evidence.quote: From left to right, the notes are: Mi Re Do Ti La So Fa.

object: So La Mi Re Do Re Do Re
text: Song 1, Frogfucius' Suite #18, is found on a piece of paper behind Frogfucius at Tadpole Pond once Rose Town is unlocked; play So La Mi Re Do Re Do Re.

evidence.quote: 1| Frogfucius' Suite #18| At Tadpole Pond, on a piece of paper behind Frogfucius. Available as soon as you unlock Rose Town.| So La Mi Re Do Re Do Re

subject: Moleville Blues
object: Mi Do So Do Re La Ti Do
text: Song 2, Moleville Blues, is found in Moleville Mountain after the third Star Piece by talking to the miners near the blown-up wall; play Mi Do So Do Re La Ti Do.

evidence.quote: 2| Moleville Blues| In Moleville Mountain after you've obtained the third Star Piece. Talk to the miners near where you blew up the wall.| Mi Do So Do Re La Ti Do

subject: Star Song
object: La Ti Do Re So Do Re Mi
text: Song 3, Star Song, is in the first house on the left in Monstro Town: talk to the star upstairs; play La Ti Do Re So Do Re Mi.

evidence.quote: 3| Star Song| In Monstro Town, first house on the left. Talk to the star upstairs to hear the song. Available as soon as you reach Monstro Town.| La Ti Do Re So Do Re Mi

subject: Toadofsky
text: After the Star Song, Toadofsky asks you to write a conclusion to the piece, and you can input any melody.

evidence.quote: After the Star Song, Toadofsky will ask you to write a conclusion to the piece. You can input any melody you like.

subject: Toadofsky
text: After successfully playing a song for Toadofsky he gives a card, which allows buying items at the Juice Bar in Tadpole Pond.

evidence.quote: After you successfully play a song for Toadofsky, he'll give you a card. These cards will allow you to buy items at the Juice Bar in Tadpole Pond (left of the tadpole bridge to Frogfucius on the mainland).

subject: Alto Card

evidence.quote: Alto| Frogfucius' Suit #18| Froggie Drink (14 Coins), Elixir (38 Coins)
